quit.completeBody: Every agent saved its memory and the orchestrator confirmed the shutdown. The harness closes itself in a moment.
quit.progressBody: The orchestrator broadcast closing time. Every worker parks its work, saves its memory, and reports back — the app closes only after the orchestrator confirms nothing will be lost.
quit.workersConfirmedWaiting: {{acked}} / {{total}} WORKERS CONFIRMED — WAITING FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR
quit.noWorkers: NO WORKERS ON THE FLOOR — WAITING FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR
quit.timeoutNote: This is taking a while (an agent may be mid-compaction or deep in a tool call). Keep waiting, or force quit and accept the data loss.
quit.warnOne: Closing the harness will terminate the running claude session and discard any unsaved progress they were holding in memory. The conversation history inside each session is lost when the PTY exits.
quit.warnMany: Closing the harness will terminate all {{count}} running claude sessions and discard any unsaved progress they were holding in memory. The conversation history inside each session is lost when the PTY exits.
quit.tip: Tip: closing time is the safe way out — the orchestrator has every agent commit its work and save its memory, and the app closes itself once the whole floor has confirmed. No data loss.

hivePicker.title: SELECT A HARNESS CONFIG
hivePicker.intro: A harness config is the folder where the app keeps everything for one workspace — its settings, your agents and their memory, tasks, triggers, and history. Each config is separate and self-contained, so you can run different setups side by side. Open the one you were working in, switch to another, or start a new one.

freellmapi.setupTitle: Setup (you install and run it yourself)
freellmapi.step1: Windows: download the FreeLLMAPI installer (.exe) from GitHub Releases and install it. (Docker also works.)
freellmapi.step2: Start FreeLLMAPI and open the dashboard at http://localhost:3001 in your browser. (Desktop app: tray icon → Open Dashboard)
freellmapi.step3: On the Keys page, add keys for the free providers you want. Get each key from that provider's own site.
freellmapi.step4: Copy the unified key starting with "freellmapi-" from the top of the Keys page (desktop app: the tray popover).
freellmapi.step5: Paste the unified key below, save it, and press "Test connection". Then pick the FreeLLMAPI character in Add Agent.
freellmapi.warn1: It only stacks free tiers, so there are no frontier models.
freellmapi.warn2: Latency varies, and quality can drop late in the day as top models hit their caps (resets at UTC midnight).
freellmapi.warn3: The project itself says it is "for personal experimentation and learning, not production".
freellmapi.warn4: Each provider's terms of service still apply, and complying with them is your responsibility.
freellmapi.warn5: The paid Premium live catalog ($19/yr) is optional; it works without it.
freellmapi.warn6: This app does not install, download or run FreeLLMAPI. You install it and keep it running.

settings.title: Instagram
settings.intro: Paste an Instagram post/Reels link into the queue and the app opens just that one link in a separate in-app browser window, reads the caption, on-screen text and a few scenes, and Michael summarizes it. It only reads when you click [Read].
settings.passwordNote: Log in on Instagram's own page. This app never asks for, receives or stores your password. The login stays only in the in-app browser's own storage.
settings.transcribeTitle: Video voice transcription (optional, off by default)
settings.transcribeIntro: Choose whether speech in videos is turned into text. When off, audio is reported as not read.
settings.offDetail: Audio is not read. No cost; audio is never sent anywhere.
settings.localDetail: Processed on this PC only. No cost.
settings.groqDetail: Uses the Groq key from the Voice tab. Free within Groq's free tier; beyond that Groq's pricing applies. Audio (up to 90 s) is sent to Groq's servers.
settings.limits: One link at a time, only when you click. No video files are downloaded, nothing is liked, commented or messaged, and only what your own logged-in browser shows is read. If Instagram blocks automated reading you get the reason and the paste-caption fallback.

workspace.needsGod: Available once the orchestrator is in.

meetings.d1: Your microphone is recorded in ~30 second pieces and sent to Groq (an external speech-to-text service). The audio and what was said leave this computer.
meetings.d2: Cost: Groq bills speech-to-text by audio length (or counts it against a free tier). This app could not verify current prices — check the pricing page on groq.com yourself. It uses the Groq key from Settings → Voice.
meetings.d3: Microphone permission is required. The app opens the mic only while a meeting is recording.
meetings.d4: Only this computer's microphone is recorded — no system audio or other apps. Sound from your speakers can still reach the mic.
meetings.d5: Other people's voices will be recorded. Tell participants and get their agreement before you start; never record secretly. A red 'recording' indicator stays visible at the top while recording.
meetings.d6: Transcripts are saved as .md files in the workspace's meetings folder. Raw audio is not kept by default (discarded after transcription). Max 3 hours per meeting.
meetings.d7: Parts that could not be transcribed are marked '[전사 실패: 구간 mm:ss]'. Completeness is not guaranteed.
meetings.offByDefault: Until you agree this feature stays off and the mic is never opened. You can turn it off again with 'Withdraw consent' below.
meetings.engineNotReady: not ready (no on-device speech model is bundled)
meetings.titlePlaceholder: Meeting title (used in the file name)
meetings.keepAudioHint: Off (default): audio is never written to disk and is dropped after transcription. On: 30-second files are kept in a '-audio' folder next to the transcript.
meetings.tellParticipants: Let participants know you are recording
meetings.tellParticipantsBefore: Before you start, tell participants you are recording and transcribing with an external service.
meetings.previewEmpty: Text appears here once the first 30-second piece is done.
meetings.summaryQueued: Queued a summary request for {{name}} (file path only).
meetings.noGod: No orchestrator yet, so a summary can't be requested.

aiConnect.title: Connect AIs
aiConnect.buttonTip: Show the AIs that are not connected yet
aiConnect.intro: Only the AIs you have not connected yet are shown. Each one disappears from the list as soon as it is connected. Connect only the ones you need.
aiConnect.allDoneHint: You can now add an AI employee and give it work.
aiConnect.cliStep: 1. Press "Log in" to open a new window. Sign in as it asks, then close that window.
aiConnect.autoHint: The app notices automatically once you have signed in. If nothing changes, press "Check again".
aiConnect.manualHint: 2. When you have signed in, press "I connected it". (The app cannot see this AI's login by itself.)
aiConnect.manualHintAutoFailed: 2. The automatic check did not work. When you have signed in, press "I connected it".
aiConnect.apiStep: 1. Open the key page with the button below and create a key, then 2. paste it into the field and press "Save".
aiConnect.keySafe: The key is stored encrypted on this computer and never shown again.
aiConnect.testAfterSave: After saving, you can run "Connection test" under "Show connected AIs" below.
aiConnect.justConnected: {{label}} connected! Removed it from the list.
aiConnect.disconnectHint: Disconnecting puts it back in the list above, where you can connect it again.
aiConnect.autoLogoutHint: The AI's own program reports its login. To log out, do it in that program.
